texts: mixed: the lantern's name, the one-week duration and the burnt wintergloss are all right, but "alongside mire-essence" survives only as a bare surface oblique on the burning event — nothing records that the mire-essence is burned too, since the co-participant role is animate-only. Rewrite it as plain coordination so both substances are recorded as burnt: "The Stilllight Lantern burns wintergloss and mire-essence for one week."
